entries.title: Colossians 4:1
segments: ¶Masters, give your bondservants what is just and fair, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.

entries.title: Colossians 4:2
segments: ¶Continue earnestly in prayer, being vigilant in it with thanksgiving;

entries.title: Colossians 4:3
segments: meanwhile praying also for us, that God would open to us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in chains,

entries.title: Colossians 4:4
segments: that I may make it manifest, as I ought to speak.

entries.title: Colossians 4:5
segments: ¶Walk in wisdom toward those [who are] outside, redeeming the time.

entries.title: Colossians 4:6
segments: [Let] your speech always [be] with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.

entries.title: Colossians 4:7
segments: ¶Tychicus, a beloved brother, faithful minister, and fellow servant in the Lord, will tell you all the news about me.

entries.title: Colossians 4:8
segments: I am sending him to you for this very purpose, that he may know your circumstances and comfort your hearts,

entries.title: Colossians 4:9
segments: with Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother, who is [one] of you. They will make known to you all things which [are happening] here.

entries.title: Colossians 4:10
segments: Aristarchus my fellow prisoner greets you, with Mark the cousin of Barnabas (about whom you received instructions: if he comes to you, welcome him),

entries.title: Colossians 4:11
segments: and Jesus who is called Justus. These [are my] only fellow workers for the kingdom of God who are of the circumcision; they have proved to be a comfort to me.

entries.title: Colossians 4:12
segments: Epaphras, who is [one] of you, a bondservant of Christ, greets you, always laboring fervently for you in prayers, that you may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.

entries.title: Colossians 4:13
segments: For I bear him witness that he has a great zeal for you, and those who are in Laodicea, and those in Hierapolis.

entries.title: Colossians 4:14
segments: Luke the beloved physician and Demas greet you.

entries.title: Colossians 4:15
segments: Greet the brethren who are in Laodicea, and Nymphas and the church that [is] in his house.

entries.title: Colossians 4:16
segments: Now when this epistle is read among you, see that it is read also in the church of the Laodiceans, and that you likewise read the epistle from Laodicea.

entries.title: Colossians 4:17
segments: And say to Archippus, "Take heed to the ministry which you have received in the Lord, that you may fulfill it."

entries.title: Colossians 4:18
segments: This salutation by my own hand--Paul. Remember my chains. Grace [be] with you. Amen.
